question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
gold_answer: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 25%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Response and Additional Evidence of Capability - 10%; 4. Competitiveness & Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
acceptance: Accept faithful shorter criterion names with correct mapping 25/40/10/25. Supporting subcriteria are optional.
candidate_answer:
The TMRS global custody RFP uses four weighted criteria to evaluate respondents:

| Evaluation criterion | Weight |
|---|---:|
| Scope affirmation, servicing approach, and institutional credentials | 25% |
| Core and value-added services and technology platforms | 40% |
| Quality of response and additional evidence of capability | 10% |
| Competitiveness and reasonableness of economics | 25% |

The economics criterion considers fees **relative to service quality**, not simply the lowest price. TMRS may also account for estimated transition costs and risks. Source: *TMRS Global Custody and Related Services RFP*, Section V, p. 22.
